meta.title: refactor toc components to client
meta.body_summary: Refactor Table of Contents components from server to client by precomputing entries and reducing RSC payload from 1.3Mb to 800Kb.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex refactored TOC components to client components, reducing RSC payload size from 1.3Mb to 800Kb; review feedback on types and structure addressed before merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 512 changed lines across 9 files, this is a medium-sized refactor by absolute volume. It fits a typical frontend performance PR that merges after review-driven adjustments and a narrative payload-size improvement claim.

review_details.concern_detail: SamyPesse suggested removing //@ts-ignore, creating a proper union type for ClientTOCPage, adding a comment to explain the helper's purpose, and moving removeUndefined to lib/typescript. All suggestions were implemented in follow-up commits.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Refactoring React Server Components to Client Components with type and serialization helper is within agent frontend capability; merge required only minor type adjustments and comment additions.

detection_detail.code_reading: SamyPesse reviewed the encoding helper and component changes, suggested union type for ClientTOCPage, removing ts-ignore, adding explanatory comment, and moving removeUndefined to a shared library.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Author claimed reduction on a specific site (mariadb.com/release-notes) but provided no reproducible measurement steps.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: All review comments were resolved via follow-up commits: removed @ts-ignore, added comments, moved helper, improved types.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored Table of Contents components (PagesList, PageDocumentItem, PageGroupItem, PageLinkItem) from server to client components by precomputing TOC entries via encodeClientTableOfContents, which resolves links and flattens pages with paths, and simplifies component props. Added removeUndefined helper for RSC serialization.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: PageIcon type relaxed to accept null; moved removeUndefined to lib/typescript.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: refactor all TOC components to client, new encodeClientTableOfContents helper.
Fix types and remove undefined: clean up types, add removeUndefined in helper, remove @ts-ignore.
Create insights directly in client component: move insight creation to client.
Review fix: apply review comments: add union type for ClientTOCPage, add comment, move helper.
Apply suggestion: update biome ignore comment per reviewer.

review_signals.summary: Noted the leftover //@ts-ignore and suggested proper union type for ClientTOCPage.
Requested a comment to explain why encodeClientTableOfContents is needed.
Suggested using a discriminated union to distinguish href only on type: 'link'.
review_signals.action_taken: ClientTOCPage type reworked to union in subsequent commits.

review_signals.summary: Suggested a more descriptive biome ignore comment.
